Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Pallavi - 38 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Manoj - 46 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Kavya - 12 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Rishabh - 10 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Nikhil is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Pallavi stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nikhil wakes up and rubs his eyes.]

Nikhil: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

Rishabh: "Uncle, look over here."

[Nikhil catches the ball.]

Manoj: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil swings on the swing.]

Manoj (softly): "I knew it!"

[Nikhil plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

[Nikhil does yoga on a mat.]

Nikhil: "That was such a fun day!"
